data.name: HELP_GENERAL_TITLE
data.value: User Guide

data.name: HELP_GENERAL_OVERVIEW
data.value: Welcome to the Monitoring and Evaluation Platform. This system helps you track development projects, measure performance indicators, and assess impact across multiple frameworks.

data.name: HELP_GENERAL_HOWTO_1
data.value: Use the sidebar navigation to access different sections of the platform.

data.name: HELP_GENERAL_HOWTO_2
data.value: Select a framework from the top navigation to view its structure and performance.

data.name: HELP_GENERAL_HOWTO_3
data.value: Use the Dashboard to get an overview of all project metrics and performance indicators.

data.name: HELP_GENERAL_FAQ_Q1
data.value: How do I change the language?

data.name: HELP_GENERAL_FAQ_A1
data.value: Use the language dropdown in the sidebar or top navigation bar to switch between Arabic and English.

data.name: HELP_GENERAL_FAQ_Q2
data.value: How do I export data?

data.name: HELP_GENERAL_FAQ_A2
data.value: Most data tables include Excel and PDF export buttons in the header section. Click the appropriate button to download your data.

data.name: HELP_GENERAL_TIP_1
data.value: Use the search and filter options to quickly find specific projects or indicators.

data.name: HELP_GENERAL_TIP_2
data.value: You can switch between the Blue and Green themes using the theme selector in the navigation bar.

data.name: HELP_FRAMEWORKS_TITLE
data.value: Frameworks Help

data.name: HELP_FRAMEWORKS_OVERVIEW
data.value: The Frameworks section allows you to manage results frameworks that organize your monitoring and evaluation structure. Frameworks contain Outcomes, Outputs, SubOutputs, and Indicators in a hierarchical structure.

data.name: HELP_FRAMEWORKS_HOWTO_1
data.value: Click "Create New Framework" to add a new monitoring framework with its name and code.

data.name: HELP_FRAMEWORKS_HOWTO_2
data.value: Use the quick create form at the top to rapidly add new frameworks inline.

data.name: HELP_FRAMEWORKS_HOWTO_3
data.value: Click on a framework name to view its detailed hierarchy of Outcomes, Outputs, and Indicators.

data.name: HELP_FRAMEWORKS_FAQ_Q1
data.value: What is the hierarchy structure?

data.name: HELP_FRAMEWORKS_FAQ_A1
data.value: Frameworks follow this hierarchy: Framework → Outcome → Output → SubOutput → Indicator → Project. Performance metrics flow upward through this structure.

data.name: HELP_FRAMEWORKS_FAQ_Q2
data.value: How is performance calculated?

data.name: HELP_FRAMEWORKS_FAQ_A2
data.value: Performance is calculated from project-level plans and propagates upward through indicators, sub-outputs, outputs, and outcomes to the framework level.

data.name: HELP_FRAMEWORKS_TIP_1
data.value: Use the filter sidebar to view frameworks by Ministry, Donor, or Sector.

data.name: HELP_FRAMEWORKS_TIP_2
data.value: The performance progress bar shows the overall achievement rate for each framework.

data.name: HELP_PROJECTS_TITLE
data.value: Projects Help

data.name: HELP_PROJECTS_OVERVIEW
data.value: The Projects section allows you to manage development projects, track their progress, and link them to indicators. Each project can have action plans, activities, and performance measurements.

data.name: HELP_PROJECTS_HOWTO_1
data.value: Click "Create New Project" to add a new project with its details, location, and associations.

data.name: HELP_PROJECTS_HOWTO_2
data.value: Use the filters on the left to search by Ministry, Donor, or Sector.

data.name: HELP_PROJECTS_HOWTO_3
data.value: Click on a project name to view its details, action plans, and performance metrics.

data.name: HELP_PROJECTS_FAQ_Q1
data.value: How do I link a project to indicators?

data.name: HELP_PROJECTS_FAQ_A1
data.value: In the project details view, use the "Link to Indicators" option to associate the project with relevant performance indicators.

data.name: HELP_PROJECTS_FAQ_Q2
data.value: What are the different plan types?

data.name: HELP_PROJECTS_FAQ_A2
data.value: Projects can have Financial, Physical, Disbursement Performance, Field Monitoring, and Impact Assessment plans to track different aspects of implementation.

data.name: HELP_PROJECTS_TIP_1
data.value: Sort projects by clicking on column headers to find high or low performing projects quickly.

data.name: HELP_PROJECTS_TIP_2
data.value: Export project lists to Excel for detailed offline analysis and reporting.

data.name: HELP_MONITORING_TITLE
data.value: Monitoring Help

data.name: HELP_MONITORING_OVERVIEW
data.value: The Monitoring section provides a comprehensive view of project and indicator performance. Track planned vs realized values and monitor progress across all levels of the hierarchy.

data.name: HELP_MONITORING_HOWTO_1
data.value: Select a framework to view its monitoring data at different hierarchy levels.

data.name: HELP_MONITORING_HOWTO_2
data.value: Navigate through Outcomes, Outputs, SubOutputs, and Indicators to see detailed performance.

data.name: HELP_MONITORING_HOWTO_3
data.value: Enter planned and realized values in the Measures section to update performance calculations.

data.name: HELP_MONITORING_FAQ_Q1
data.value: How often should I update monitoring data?

data.name: HELP_MONITORING_FAQ_A1
data.value: Regular updates are recommended based on your reporting cycle (monthly, quarterly, or annually) to maintain accurate performance tracking.

data.name: HELP_MONITORING_FAQ_Q2
data.value: What do the progress bar colors mean?

data.name: HELP_MONITORING_FAQ_A2
data.value: Green indicates good performance (above target), yellow shows moderate progress, orange indicates below target, and red shows critical underperformance.

data.name: HELP_MONITORING_TIP_1
data.value: Use the breadcrumb navigation to quickly move between hierarchy levels.

data.name: HELP_MONITORING_TIP_2
data.value: Click on indicator weights to adjust how performance is aggregated at higher levels.

data.name: HELP_INDICATORS_TITLE
data.value: Indicators Help

data.name: HELP_INDICATORS_OVERVIEW
data.value: Indicators are measurable performance metrics that track progress toward outcomes and outputs. Each indicator has a target value and can be linked to multiple projects.

data.name: HELP_INDICATORS_HOWTO_1
data.value: Click "Add Indicator" to create a new indicator with its name and target value.

data.name: HELP_INDICATORS_HOWTO_2
data.value: Use "Add & Create Project" to simultaneously create an indicator and link it to a new project.

data.name: HELP_INDICATORS_HOWTO_3
data.value: Adjust indicator weights to control how they contribute to aggregate performance.

data.name: HELP_INDICATORS_FAQ_Q1
data.value: What are indicator weights?

data.name: HELP_INDICATORS_FAQ_A1
data.value: Weights determine how much each indicator contributes to the performance calculation at the SubOutput level. Higher weights mean greater influence on the aggregate score.

data.name: HELP_INDICATORS_FAQ_Q2
data.value: How do I link indicators to projects?

data.name: HELP_INDICATORS_FAQ_A2
data.value: Use the Measures section to create links between indicators and projects, then enter planned and realized values to track progress.

data.name: HELP_INDICATORS_TIP_1
data.value: Use inline editing to quickly update indicator names without navigating to a separate page.

data.name: HELP_OUTCOMES_TITLE
data.value: Outcomes Help

data.name: HELP_OUTCOMES_OVERVIEW
data.value: Outcomes represent the high-level results expected from your framework. They contain Outputs which further break down into SubOutputs and Indicators.

data.name: HELP_OUTCOMES_HOWTO_1
data.value: Navigate to a framework and click "Add Outcome" to create a new outcome.

data.name: HELP_OUTCOMES_HOWTO_2
data.value: Click on an outcome name to view and manage its outputs.

data.name: HELP_OUTCOMES_HOWTO_3
data.value: Use "Adjust Weights" to control how outputs contribute to the outcome's performance.

data.name: HELP_OUTCOMES_FAQ_Q1
data.value: What is the relationship between outcomes and outputs?

data.name: HELP_OUTCOMES_FAQ_A1
data.value: Outcomes are achieved through outputs. Each outcome can have multiple outputs, and the outcome's performance is calculated from its weighted outputs.

data.name: HELP_OUTCOMES_FAQ_Q2
data.value: Can I move outputs between outcomes?

data.name: HELP_OUTCOMES_FAQ_A2
data.value: Yes, you can edit an output and change its parent outcome to reorganize your framework structure.

data.name: HELP_OUTCOMES_TIP_1
data.value: Use meaningful outcome names that clearly describe the expected result.

data.name: HELP_OUTCOMES_TIP_2
data.value: Review outcome weights regularly to ensure they reflect your monitoring priorities.

data.name: HELP_OUTPUTS_TITLE
data.value: Outputs Help

data.name: HELP_OUTPUTS_OVERVIEW
data.value: Outputs are the deliverables that contribute to achieving outcomes. They contain SubOutputs which link to specific indicators and projects.

data.name: HELP_OUTPUTS_HOWTO_1
data.value: From an outcome view, click "Add Output" to create a new output.

data.name: HELP_OUTPUTS_HOWTO_2
data.value: Click on an output name to view its sub-outputs and indicators.

data.name: HELP_OUTPUTS_HOWTO_3
data.value: Adjust sub-output weights from the output view to control aggregation.

data.name: HELP_OUTPUTS_FAQ_Q1
data.value: How many outputs should an outcome have?

data.name: HELP_OUTPUTS_FAQ_A1
data.value: There's no strict limit, but typically 3-7 outputs per outcome provides a good balance between detail and manageability.

data.name: HELP_OUTPUTS_FAQ_Q2
data.value: What if an output has no sub-outputs?

data.name: HELP_OUTPUTS_FAQ_A2
data.value: Outputs should have at least one sub-output to connect to indicators. Create sub-outputs to properly track output performance.

data.name: HELP_OUTPUTS_TIP_1
data.value: Output codes help with reporting and data export. Use consistent naming conventions.

data.name: HELP_OUTPUTS_TIP_2
data.value: The output performance bar shows the weighted average of all its sub-outputs.

data.name: HELP_SUBOUTPUTS_TITLE
data.value: SubOutputs Help

data.name: HELP_SUBOUTPUTS_OVERVIEW
data.value: SubOutputs break down outputs into more specific components and link directly to indicators. They represent the most granular level of the results framework before indicators.

data.name: HELP_SUBOUTPUTS_HOWTO_1
data.value: From an output view, click "Add SubOutput" to create a new sub-output.

data.name: HELP_SUBOUTPUTS_HOWTO_2
data.value: Click on a sub-output to view and manage its indicators.

data.name: HELP_SUBOUTPUTS_HOWTO_3
data.value: Use the Projects List view to see all projects linked through this sub-output's indicators.

data.name: HELP_SUBOUTPUTS_FAQ_Q1
data.value: What's the purpose of sub-outputs?

data.name: HELP_SUBOUTPUTS_FAQ_A1
data.value: Sub-outputs provide an additional layer of organization between outputs and indicators, allowing for more detailed tracking and reporting.

data.name: HELP_SUBOUTPUTS_FAQ_Q2
data.value: How do I see all projects for a sub-output?

data.name: HELP_SUBOUTPUTS_FAQ_A2
data.value: Navigate to SubOutputs → Projects List to see all projects linked through the sub-output's indicators.

data.name: HELP_SUBOUTPUTS_TIP_1
data.value: Keep sub-output names specific and measurable to make reporting clearer.

data.name: HELP_SUBOUTPUTS_TIP_2
data.value: Use indicator weights within sub-outputs to prioritize key performance metrics.

data.value: Measures Help

data.value: Measures link projects to indicators and track planned versus realized values. They are the foundation for calculating performance metrics throughout the system.

data.name: HELP_MEASURES_HOWTO_2

data.name: HELP_MEASURES_HOWTO_3

data.value: What happens when I update a measure?

data.name: HELP_MEASURES_TIP_2

data.name: HELP_FrameworkGoals_TITLE
data.value: Framework Goals - Performance Calculations

data.name: HELP_FrameworkGoals_OVERVIEW
data.value:
Framework Goals track progress toward strategic targets.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 1. GOAL TYPES ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• Upward Target (Target > Base Value) - Value should INCREASE over time - Example: Literacy rate from 60% to 90%
• Downward Target (Target < Base Value) - Value should DECREASE over time - Example: Poverty rate from 40% to 15%
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 2. CALCULATION FORMULAS ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• Discount Rate: = |Target Value - Base Value| ÷ Number of Years
• Progress (Upward Target): = Actual Value - Starting Base Value
• Progress (Downward Target): = Starting Base Value - Actual Value
• Performance Percentage: = (Progress ÷ (Discount Rate × Years Elapsed)) × 100
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 3. COLOR CODING ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• 🟢 Green: ≥100% (On track or exceeding) • 🟡 Yellow: 50-99% (Moderate progress) • 🔴 Red: <50% (Below expected)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 4. EXAMPLE CALCULATION ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Given: • Base Value (2020): 100 • Target Value (2025): 80 • Actual Value (2023): 88
Calculation: • Goal Type: Downward (80 < 100) • Discount Rate: |80-100| ÷ 5 = 4/year • Progress: 100 - 88 = 12 • Years Elapsed: 2023 - 2020 = 3 • Performance: (12 ÷ (4 × 3)) × 100 = 100%

data.name: HELP_FrameworkGoals_HOWTO_1
data.value: **Discount Rate Calculation:** The Annual Discount Rate is calculated as the absolute difference between Base Value and Target Value, divided by the number of years: |Target - Base| / Years. This represents the expected annual change needed to reach the target.

data.name: HELP_FrameworkGoals_HOWTO_2
data.value: **Yearly Performance:** Select a year from the dropdown to see performance for that specific year. Performance is calculated by comparing the actual value for that year against the expected progress based on the discount rate and years elapsed from the starting year.

data.name: HELP_FrameworkGoals_HOWTO_3
data.value: **Sparkline Charts:** The mini-charts show the trajectory from Starting Year (S) to Current Year (C) to Target Year (T). Green sparklines indicate upward targets where values should increase. Red sparklines indicate downward targets where values should decrease.

data.name: HELP_FrameworkGoals_FAQ_Q1
data.value: How is the Discount Rate calculated?

data.name: HELP_FrameworkGoals_FAQ_A1
data.value: The Annual Discount Rate = |Target Value - Base Value| / (Target Year - Starting Year). For example, if Base=100 in 2020, Target=80 in 2025, the Discount Rate = |80-100| / 5 = 4 per year. This means the value should decrease by 4 units each year to reach the target.

data.name: HELP_FrameworkGoals_FAQ_Q2
data.value: What happens when progress is negative?

data.name: HELP_FrameworkGoals_FAQ_A2
data.value: Negative progress means the goal is moving in the wrong direction. For upward targets, this occurs when the actual value is less than the starting base value. For downward targets, this occurs when the actual value is greater than the starting base value. In both cases, performance is shown as 0% with a red indicator.

data.name: HELP_FrameworkGoals_TIP_1
data.value: **Quick Reference:** Upward Target = actual should increase above base value. Downward Target = actual should decrease below base value. The system automatically detects the target direction by comparing Target Value to Base Value for the Starting Year.

data.name: HELP_FrameworkGoals_TIP_2
data.value: **Export Options:** Use the Excel and PDF export buttons to download goal data for reporting. The Timeline view shows a visual comparison of progress across all years from starting to target year.
